soundness_flags.label: Theorem 2 (smooth-stratum inference)
soundness_flags.one_line: The rank hypothesis is only along S, but empirical laws generally leave a lower-dimensional equality-guard stratum, so it does not justify rank(Σ̂_F)=r or the stated pseudoinverse Wald limit off S.

soundness_flags.label: Definition of W_N and Theorem 2
soundness_flags.one_line: r may be zero for a locally constant returned functional, yet χ²_{r,1-α} is used without a zero-rank convention or an assumption r≥1.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 1 (Global-CID)
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The paired collision compressor and ranked overlap saturation, including their support, termination, and size guarantees, are assumed open subroutines rather than established results.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Global-CID is a conditional compilation theorem only under certified solutions of both open construction questions; this conditional component is capped at field tier.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 6 states that ID is sound and complete for causal effects in a C-DAG and returns a formula valid in every compatible causal diagram.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v2, 2 September 2025; corresponding TMLR primary PDF was access-blocked
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4 is rule-level completeness under the cluster-size assumption; §4 identifies the known adjacent-singleton excluded regime, and the conclusion explicitly leaves reconciliation of differing rule iterations unresolved.
The paper gives a sufficient simultaneous-identification criterion for a candidate set of SA-MPDAGs, requiring local identifiability plus one of two cross-candidate graphical conditions.

Equivalent single-ADMG interventional expressions admit a four-rule normal form; the paper explicitly says that full ID-algebra derivation spaces are generally infinite and asks for meaningful finite representations or tractable subclasses.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Require covariance rank stability on an open neighborhood in the simplex, or define a rank-adaptive nonregular procedure; separately define the r=0 confidence region.

Promote the four-node collision into a parameterized nondegenerate family and prove that its exact known-size regime lies strictly outside Ferreira–Assaad Assumption 1 while preserving a common positive law and effect separation.

State a dedicated strict-extension result comparing the exact-known-size refinement-union class to both acyclic C-DAG ID and the cyclic C-DMG rule criterion, rather than leaving that comparison distributed across prose.

recommended_next_step: Revise the smooth-stratum inference target to supply off-stratum rank regularity and a zero-rank convention, then retain the conditional compiler scope and advance the field-level collision/overlap kernel.
